rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a blastocyst and notes image limitations, but overstates confidence in AA features; the ICM is not clearly tightly packed on this image, TE cohesion is difficult to confirm, and calling it a good-quality Day-4 early/full blastocyst is somewhat inconsistent with the provided Day-4 transfer context and reported 2AA.

Integrates age, low AMH, first cycle status, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, and lifestyle factors well, and appropriately distinguishes embryo morphology from age-related aneuploidy risk and ovarian reserve effects.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a logical link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include some ambiguity around Day-4 blastocyst timing and a somewhat optimistic implantation estimate.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer, avoiding unproven add-ons, and individualized PGT-A discussion; slight deviation is the relatively confident prognosis for an untested embryo at age 36.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management, luteal support, alcohol cessation, monitoring, and future cycle planning; useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain general rather than protocol-specific.
